subject.title: fix(tts): allow trusted local media in message_tool_only mode

question: Should verified local TTS media be permitted to bypass `message_tool_only` suppression after text is stripped, or should this remain fully suppressed until a different delivery contract is designed?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes the confidentiality and delivery boundary for ambient room-event replies; source-level tests can show mechanics but cannot choose the permanent trust policy.

options.title: Approve the narrow trusted-media exception
options.body: Allow the media-only path after exact-head live proof confirms a voice delivery with no outbound source or final text.

options.title: Keep suppression absolute
options.body: Reject this exception and require a separately designed, explicitly routed channel-delivery contract for TTS media.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow trusted-media exception
recommendation.body: Allow the media-only path after exact-head live proof confirms a voice delivery with no outbound source or final text.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline routes the prior maintainer-look decision to this contact, and the remaining question is product and trust-policy intent rather than a mechanical test failure.
